mainObjective: Provide a compact arena for scripted gameplay captures: cross the waystone yard, trigger the goblin scuffle in the training pit, then talk with Warden Mira and work the locked cellar door at the reliquary alcove.

plotPoints.title: Arrival at the Waystone Gate
plotPoints.description: The party stands at the Waystone Gate of the capture arena. The training pit east of the gate holds a hostile goblin scuffle, and the reliquary alcove to the south shelters Warden Mira beside a locked cellar door.
